bot.help:
Send a voice message and I will type it into the WoW chat.

I pick the channel from the meaning or from the first words: “party, …”, “guild, …”, “whisper Arthorn …”, “reply to him …”, “yell …”, “trade, …”.

Commands:
/status — is the agent on your PC connected
/channel group|guild|say|raid — default channel
/confirm on|off — ask before sending
/style <how to write> — rewrite messages (for example: “like an orc shaman”), /style off — turn it off
/names Arthorn, Liana — nicknames you often say
/channels — chat channels from the game
/panel — pin the control panel
/widgets on|off — cards and the panel, or plain buttons
/language — bot language
